summary: Prepare to audit ISO 22301 business continuity management systems, practise audit methods, and prepare for the PECB Lead Auditor exam.
audienceIntro: ISO 22301 Lead Auditor training suits professionals who assess BCMS conformity, coordinate audit work, or prepare organizations for BCMS audits. You should be ready to apply audit principles to business continuity requirements and evidence.
prerequisites: To attend, you need a fundamental understanding of business continuity concepts and comprehensive knowledge of BCMS audit principles.
